critical.name: 95% Truth Gate
critical.description: No statement enters the canonical record unless verified to 95% confidence.

critical.name: No Delete Policy
critical.description: Information is never destroyed. Supersede, annotate, archive — never purge.

critical.name: Century Reassembly Rule
critical.description: All artifacts must be reconstructable from primary sources within 100 years.

critical.name: Cathedral + Satellites
critical.description: One central canonical source with specialized satellite nodes.

critical.name: Ring of Perspectives
critical.description: Every significant decision requires synthesis from multiple viewpoints.

critical.name: Hollow Vessel
critical.description: AI serves as a vessel for truth, not ego.
